# SideCal

> Free, open-source sidebar calendar for macOS. Shows today's Apple Calendar as a 24-hour timeline on the screen edge, lets you zoom into your day and move or resize events by dragging, and shows your next event in the menu bar. No telemetry, no network calls unless you enable the optional update check. Has a local MCP server mode (sidecal --mcp) so AI assistants (Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients) can read the calendar and time-block it. Built with Rust and Tauri. Apache 2.0.

- [Website](https://kacpergorec.github.io/sidecal/)
- [Documentation](https://kacpergorec.github.io/sidecal/documentation.html): install, usage, settings, shortcuts
- [Download](https://github.com/kacpergorec/sidecal/releases/latest): Apple Silicon and Intel builds, macOS 14 or later
- [Claude Desktop extension](https://github.com/kacpergorec/sidecal/releases/latest/download/SideCal.mcpb): one-click MCP setup for Claude Desktop (install SideCal first)
- [Source](https://github.com/kacpergorec/sidecal)
